title: Pioneer-factor activity requires stable chromatin occupancy mediated by both sequence-specific binding and disordered protein domains
authors: Meghan M. Freund; F. Javier deHaro-Arbona; Sarah Baloul; Ali Torhorst; Charalambos Roussos; Abby J. Ruffridge; Andrew Q. Rashoff; Ryen Hazzard; Peter W. Lewis; Sarah J. Bray; Melissa M. Harrison
one_liner_zh: 该文研究先锋转录因子Grainy head通过序列特异性DNA结合域和内在无序N端共同介导稳定染色质占据以支持先锋活性，虽聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，但方法以生化、基因组学和活细胞成像为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评分为6。
abstract: Pioneer transcription factors overcome the restrictive barrier imposed by chromatin to drive cell-fate specification, yet how their domains collectively support this activity remains unclear. Here, we use the deeply conserved pioneer factor Grainy head to define the protein-intrinsic features that govern pioneering activity. By integrating biochemistry, genomics and quantitative live-cell imaging, we determined that both the conserved DNA-binding domain and the extended, intrinsically disordered N-terminus are required for the stable chromatin occupancy that supports access to closed chromatin and the induction of chromatin accessibility. The disordered N-terminus supports pioneer activity through interactions that do not rely on strict amino acid sequence but instead overall composition. While our results show that pioneering activity depends on the combinatorial contributions of structured and disordered domains, mitotic retention depends solely on sequence-specific DNA binding. These results support stable chromatin occupancy mediated by multiple protein domains as necessary for pioneering function and that this is separable from the mechanisms required for mitotic retention.
abstract_zh: 先驱转录因子克服染色质所施加的限制性屏障以驱动细胞命运特化，但其结构域如何协同支持这一活性仍不清楚。在此，我们利用深度保守的先驱因子Grainy head来定义调控先驱活性的蛋白质内在特征。通过整合生物化学、基因组学和定量活细胞成像，我们确定保守的DNA结合结构域和延伸的、内在无序的N端对于稳定的染色质占据是必需的，这种占据支持对闭合染色质的访问及染色质可及性的诱导。无序的N端通过不依赖严格氨基酸序列而依赖整体组成的相互作用来支持先驱活性。尽管我们的结果表明先驱活性依赖于结构化结构域和无序结构域的组合贡献，但有丝分裂保留仅依赖于序列特异性DNA结合。这些结果支持由多个蛋白质结构域介导的稳定染色质占据是先驱功能所必需的，并且这与有丝分裂保留所需的机制是可分离的。
